scenes.description: Benny and Kid Checking Coins and Pocket Money at Home
Friendly Neighborhood Bakery Counter with Fresh Bread
Paying Cash at the Cashier and Receiving the Receipt

character_line.en: We are going shopping! How much money do we have in our piggy bank?
character_line.zh: 我們要去買東西了！我們的存錢筒裡有多少錢呢？

options.en: We have ten dollars in shiny coins!
options.zh: 我們有十元的閃亮硬幣！

options.hint: 數數存錢筒裡的硬幣「ten dollars in coins」告訴 Benny 喔！
告訴 Benny 我們準備了多少零錢要去買東西吧！

character_line.en: Ten dollars! What delicious treat do you want to buy?
character_line.zh: 十元！你想買什麼好吃的點心呢？

options.en: I want to buy a sweet strawberry bun!
options.zh: 我想買一個香甜的草莓麵包！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 你想買「buy」什麼好吃的點心吧！
麵包店裡有香甜草莓麵包，說「I want to buy...」喔！

character_line.en: Smell that fresh bread! How much is this warm bread?
character_line.zh: 聞聞看這新鮮麵包的香味！這個熱騰騰的麵包多少錢？

options.hint: 看看價錢標籤，回答「It is five dollars」喔！
告訴 Benny 麵包一個只要五元喔！

character_line.en: That is a great price! Can we also buy a small juice?
character_line.zh: 價格好划算！我們還可以再買一瓶小果汁嗎？

options.en: Yes, we still have five dollars left!

options.hint: 算算看：十元買了五元麵包，還剩下五元「five dollars left」喔！
告訴 Benny 我們的零錢剛剛好還可以買一瓶小果汁喔！

character_line.en: Now we are at the cashier! How should we pay?
character_line.zh: 現在我們來到收銀台了！我們該怎麼付款呢？

options.en: Here is ten dollars cash, please!

options.hint: 有禮貌地把現金拿給店員「Here is ten dollars」喔！
在收銀台結帳要拿錢並說「please」喔！

character_line.en: The clerk gave us our warm bread and receipt! What should we say?
character_line.zh: 店員把熱騰騰的麵包和發票交給我們了！我們該說什麼呢？

options.en: Thank you very much! Have a nice day!
options.zh: 非常謝謝您！祝您有美好的一天！

options.hint: 結帳完成接過麵包，記得說「Thank you very much」喔！
禮貌地祝店員有美好的一天「Have a nice day」吧！
